_favour_note: Tides of War (4.8.1) distinguishes 'Favour' from 'Most Favour'. REGULAR Strongholds (city/town/fortress): the side with the MOST total Favour of that type earns the Influence (one award per type, regardless of count). SPECIAL Strongholds (london/calais/harlech): Influence is awarded INDIVIDUALLY to whichever side has Favour at that specific Stronghold. The `tides_of_war.basis` field encodes which rule applies.
_schema: levy_troops/supply/tax/pillage map a force/asset id -> count; tides_of_war = {influence, basis: 'most_favour' | 'favour'}.
